chunks: When you ask them to follow what God has revealed, they say:
ai.seo_question: Why do people follow their ancestors' traditions instead of divine revelation?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the flaw of 'Taqlid al-Aba' (blind imitation of ancestors), contrasting it with the rational acceptance of divine revelation. It underscores that ancestral tradition holds no intrinsic authority if it contradicts the clear signs of God, serving as a critique of those who prioritize custom over truth even when led by the Devil.
